era: 大航海时代 / Age of Exploration (1728-1779)
school: 英国海军测绘学派 / Royal Navy Survey School
historical_significance: 詹姆斯·库克（1728-1779），英国航海家、测绘师，三次太平洋远征（1768-1779）的指挥者：完成新西兰首次环航测绘、测绘澳大利亚东海岸、以遍历式扫掠证明'未知的南方大陆'为神话、把航海天文钟与坏血病防治带入实战并制度化。其远征确立'科学家随舰'建制（此后小猎犬号沿袭），获皇家学会科普利奖章（1776）。1779年2月14日死于夏威夷凯阿拉凯夸湾冲突，成为殖民时代符号误读的标志性案例。
unique_thinking: 库克的独特性在于把'探索'改写为'工程'：仪器可信度靠大洋实战检验（K1天文钟三年误差8英里），病因不明的坏血病靠纪律强制执行有效组合（第一次航行零坏血病死亡），地图空白是逐段关闭的工作队列（新西兰环航闭环、东澳两千英里逐段测绘），流行假说靠遍历其预言位置做负证明（南大陆神话的公共葬礼），科学家是行动的常设编制（班克斯、福斯特父子随行建制）。他死于符号误读而非武器劣势——被夏威夷祭司系统在马卡希基节'加冕'为隆诺，季节更替后带着破损主桅回到同一海湾，最终以绑架人质策略触发致命冲突：接受而不经营符号者，终被符号反噬。

cross_references.relation_type: 远航工程学的两代范式：合同式单点冲刺 vs 建制式多轮迭代
cross_references.description_zh: 麦哲伦与库克是远洋探索的两代范式：麦哲伦以一次性合同动员五船一搏，用'至'证有（海峡、环球实存）；库克以海军常设建制三次远征，用'遍历'证无（南大陆负证明）与'复检'证准（K1天文钟三年实测）。同构处有三：麦哲伦'太平洋纪律'与库克'上岸窗口节律'都在处理配给与恢复的节律（M-AE-004 × M-AE-017）；麦哲伦'亲历笔录'与库克'科考随行建制'都在解决记录建制化——从一个人到一个学科（M-AE-006 × M-AE-015）；麦哲伦'宿务杠杆'与库克'身份符号管理'都暴露杠杆/符号的过期反噬（M-AE-005 × M-AE-018）。分野在死亡的意义：麦哲伦死于半途而由继任者续成使命（M-AE-007），库克死于符号误读而由档案接力传世（M-AE-020）——两人的'失败'都被制度化结构转化为完成。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 麦哲伦档案（H-AE-001）未来修订时可在'海峡试探'与'宿务杠杆'处补一条指向 H-AE-002 的跨引用（遍历式负证明与符号季节管理）。

cross_references.relation_type: 远洋组织的三种节律：国家常设/合同冲刺/科考建制
cross_references.description_zh: 郑和的'节律窗口'以季风宏观排程，库克的'上岸窗口'以恢复需求微观补给——两人都在'等待与配给'中建立纪律（M-MV-009 × M-AE-017）；郑和'耀兵不征'以规模支撑符号克制，库克在夏威夷被动接受符号而终被反噬——符号的主动经营与被动接收给出正反教材（M-MV-003 × M-AE-018）；郑和'档案断代审计'（档案因制度停转而散佚）与库克'档案接力路由'（档案经西伯利亚陆路早于船队抵英）构成档案命运的正反两极（M-MV-010 × M-AE-020）。分野在组织性质：郑和是国家机器的常设制度，库克是常设海军+临时科考建制的混合体——后者的'科学家随舰'建制成为此后两百年科学探索的标准模板。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 郑和档案（H-MV-001）未来修订时可在'节律窗口'与'档案断代审计'处补一条指向 H-AE-002 的跨引用（恢复需求定节律与档案接力路由的对照）。

cross_references.relation_type: 庙算先胜的勘探版：战前审计与遍历检验
cross_references.description_zh: 孙武'庙算先胜'（M-SW-001）在库克这里转译为双重的先胜结构：启航前以装备冗余与科考建制完成'未战庙算'（双船、双份仪器、科学团预算合约），行动中以遍历检验替代会战决胜——'先胜'的对象从敌军改为假说与未知。孙武'知己知彼'（M-SW-003）在库克的本地知识接口策略中成为组织现实：图帕亚的活海图是'知彼'的建制化形态（M-AE-016 × M-SW-003）。分野在目标的可证伪性：孙武的庙算服务于确定会战，库克的遍历服务于可证伪假说——前者以必胜为前提组织，后者以'负结果也是发现'为前提组织。
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 孙武档案（H-SW-001）未来修订时可在'庙算先胜'处补一条指向 H-AE-002 的跨引用（勘探性任务中庙算的遍历检验形态）。

图帕亚的历史地位长期被贬低为'班克斯的仆人'，其领航与传译贡献20世纪末才获重估——本地知识贡献者在欧洲档案中的署名结构性偏低

modes.name_en: The Instrument-Trial Method: Certifying a Device by Sailing It, Not by Sitting It
modes.domain_en: Scientific Methodology / Instrument Validation in the Field
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：一种测量仪器的可信度不产自钟表匠的工作台，而产自大洋上的实战检验——把'仪器是否可靠'从形而上的争论改写为一次可归档的远航任务。方法论签名有四：其一，任务内嵌试验——海军部与经度委员会把肯德尔K1航海天文钟交给第二次航行的库克，天文学者威廉·威尔士在船上逐日记录其误差，仪器与探险互为载荷；其二，对手校准——库克不依赖单一仪器，K1天文钟、月距法、木星卫星法三路互相校验，三年航行后K1误差仅约8英里；其三，环境极限测试——把仪器带到高纬度、大湿度、剧烈温差的真实海况下，而不是在伦敦的客厅里推演；其四，结论制度化——试验结果直接改写海军的导航规程，一次检验升级为全舰队的能力。这一模式把'实验'的含义从实验室扩展到整个地球：大洋即试验台，航迹即实验记录。
modes.definition_en: James Cook's master proposition: an instrument's credibility is not manufactured at the clockmaker's bench but forged in ocean-going field trials — converting 'is this device reliable?' from metaphysical dispute into a single archivable voyage. Four signatures define the mode. First, trial embedded in mission: the Board of Longitude handed Larcum Kendall's K1 chronometer to Cook's second voyage, with astronomer William Wales logging its error day by day — instrument and expedition as mutual payloads. Second, cross-calibration by rivals: Cook trusted no single device; K1, lunar distances, and Jupiter's satellites checked one another, and after three years K1 drifted only some eight miles. Third, environmental stress-testing: the instrument was carried into high latitudes, heavy humidity and violent temperature swings — real sea conditions, not a London drawing room. Fourth, institutionalized verdicts: trial results directly rewrote naval navigation practice, one trial upgrading the capability of an entire fleet. The mode stretches 'experiment' from the laboratory to the planet itself: the ocean is the test bench, the wake is the lab notebook.
modes.source_chapter: 《朝着南极并环绕世界航行》(A Voyage Towards the South Pole and Round the World, 1777)；海军部经度委员会档案 (Board of Longitude Papers) / 库克在《朝着南极并环绕世界航行》中完整公开K1与月距法的逐日比对数据：'在如此漫长的航行中，表与天各自作证' (the watch and the heavens bore witness to each other through so long a passage)
process_zh: 明确待检对象：选定K1天文钟，连同对照方法（月距法）一同登船
指定随船检验员：天文专员威尔士逐日记录K1读数与天文定位的偏差
把检验嵌入最严苛航段：高纬冰海、赤道湿热、跨洋长航全部进入样本
以归档结论收束：误差数据公开出版，直接改写海军与商船的经度测定规程
process_en: Assign the device under test: embark Kendall's K1 with its rival method (lunar distances) for comparison
Appoint an onboard examiner: astronomer William Wales logs K1 readings against astronomical fixes daily
Embed the trial in the harshest legs: high-latitude ice, equatorial humidity, long ocean crossings all enter the sample
Close with an archived verdict: published error data directly rewrites longitude practice for navy and merchant fleets
representative_cases_zh: 第二次航行（1772-1775）：K1天文钟随航三年，威尔士逐日对时，最终误差仅约8英里——钟表导航从此获得实战认证
金星凌日观测（1769）：在塔希提以谢尔顿精密钟计时凌日全程，把天体力学问题带到地球另一端实测
月距法并行使用：整个第二次航行期间天文钟与月距法互校，任一读数偏离即触发复核
反面警示：1780年代东印度公司为降低成本改用西印度酸橙汁替代地中海柠檬汁——同一'柑橘汁'标签下的有效成分骤降，1875年北极内斯远征队在足量配给'酸橙汁'下仍暴发坏血病。教训：检验结论不可脱离其检验条件迁移——库克认证的是具体装置与方法，不是标签。
反面警示：第二航行前班克斯提出远超船体承载的随行要求，迫使改装；库克拒绝迁就，班克斯退出，福斯特父子补位。教训：仪器/团队的检验载荷必须匹配载体能力，否则检验本身失败。
反面警示：K1过于精贵难以复制量产，海军长期未全面换装，月距法仍沿用数十年。教训：单点认证不等于体系替换——验证成功后还需可复制性与成本路径。
representative_cases_en: Second voyage (1772-75): the K1 sailed three years, Wales logged it daily, and final drift was only ~8 miles — chronometer navigation gained field certification
Transit of Venus (1769): at Tahiti, Shelton regulators timed the full transit, carrying celestial mechanics to the far side of the globe for ground truth
Lunar distances run in parallel: throughout the second voyage chronometer and lunar method cross-checked each other, any divergence triggering review

Cautionary: in the 1780s the East India Company switched from Mediterranean lemons to West Indian limes to cut cost — the same 'citrus juice' label with far less active principle, and the 1875 Nares Arctic expedition broke out in scurvy despite full rations of 'lime juice'. Lesson: validated conclusions do not migrate beyond their validation conditions — Cook certified a specific device and method, not a label.

Cautionary: before the second voyage Banks demanded accommodations beyond the ship's capacity, forcing refits; Cook refused to accommodate, Banks quit, and the Forsters filled in. Lesson: the trial payload must match the carrier's capacity, or the trial itself fails.

Cautionary: K1 was too precious to mass-produce; the Navy delayed full adoption and lunar distances persisted for decades. Lesson: single-point certification is not system replacement — validation success still needs a replicability and cost path.
modern_applications_zh: 新设备/新系统上线前先设'随船检验员'：把实测数据采集嵌入真实业务运行，而非实验室模拟
关键度量用两条独立路径交叉验证：仪表读数与方法算术互校，偏差即触发复核
在环境最恶劣的真实工况中采集性能样本，用极端数据建立可信边界
modern_applications_en: Before any new system goes live, embed a 'riding examiner': collect field data inside real operations, not lab simulations
Cross-validate critical measurements via two independent paths: instrument reading vs. analytic method, with divergence triggering review
Sample performance in the worst real conditions and set credibility boundaries from extreme-case data
modes.key_quote_zh: '钟表匠能造出表，只有大洋能证明它走得准。'——库克式验证哲学
modes.key_quote_en: 'The clockmaker can build the watch; only the ocean can prove it keeps time.' — the Cook school of validation

modes.name_en: The Preventive-Compulsion Method: Enforcing the Cure Before the Disease Is Understood
modes.domain_zh: 组织管理学/健康与纪律
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：当病因不明而手段有效时，正确答案不是等待病理学，而是以纪律强制执行有效手段——把'为什么有效'留给科学家，把'必须执行'留给船长。方法论签名有四：其一，多手段并行冗余——酸菜、麦芽汁、浓缩柑橘汁、鲜蔬补给、清洁通风同时上船，库克本人也不知道哪一种真正起效，但知道整套组合在起效；其二，强制执行高于说服——水手抵制酸菜，库克不让步也不辩解，而是只给军官供应、利用'军官看重的就是好东西'的从众心理让水手主动争食；其三，以结果归档——第一次航行无一人死于坏血病，方法写入《南极航行》论文并获皇家学会科普利奖章；其四，机制化推广——清洁、通风、饮食规程成为海军条令，个体经验升级为组织能力。这一模式与郑和'节律窗口'同构：都在'等待与配给'中建立纪律；但库克的独特处在于承认认知不完整仍然行动——执行先于理解。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: when the cause is unknown but the remedy works, the right answer is not to wait for pathology but to enforce the working remedy by discipline — leaving 'why it works' to scientists and 'it must be done' to the captain. Four signatures define the mode. First, redundant parallel measures: sauerkraut, malt wort, concentrated citrus, fresh greens at every landfall, cleanliness and ventilation all shipboard at once — Cook never knew which single lever worked, only that the combination did. Second, enforcement over persuasion: sailors rejected sauerkraut; Cook neither yielded nor argued — he served it to officers only, exploiting the crowd psychology that whatever officers value must be good, until sailors demanded it. Third, results as the record: not one death from scurvy on the first voyage; the method was published in the South Pole voyage account and won the Royal Society's Copley Medal. Fourth, mechanized rollout: cleanliness, ventilation, and diet regimens entered naval orders — individual experience upgraded to organizational capability. The mode is isomorphic with Zheng He's 'rhythm window': both build discipline inside waiting and rationing; Cook's distinctiveness is acting with acknowledged incomplete knowledge — execution before understanding.
modes.source_chapter: 《朝着南极并环绕世界航行》第三章论船员健康 (On the Health of Mariners)；普林格尔1776年科普利奖章演讲 / 库克记录水手心理：'只要你以通常的方式给他们东西，他们就是不领情；可一旦看到长官们看中那样东西，立刻回心转意。'
process_zh: 并行装载所有可能有效的手段，不因机理不明而取舍
以地位符号化解抵制：稀缺品先配军官，让从众心理替你完成说服
每个上岸窗口全力补给鲜蔬淡水，把航程切成一段段可恢复区间
以结果数据发表并推动成文化：从船长个人做法升级为海军条令
process_en: Load every plausibly effective measure in parallel; do not prune for want of a mechanism
Defuse resistance with status signals: scarce goods to officers first, letting conformity do the persuading
Use every landfall to restock fresh greens and water, slicing the voyage into recoverable segments
Publish the outcome data and push it into written doctrine: from a captain's habit to naval regulation
representative_cases_zh: 第一次航行（1768-1771）：全程无一人死于坏血病，创航海史纪录，方法经普林格尔认证获科普利奖章
酸菜心理战：水手拒食，库克只供军官，一周内水手主动要求配给
第二次航行（1772-1775）：三年航行仅一人病亡（非坏血病），清洁通风规程再强化
反面警示：库克本人误信'清洁与酸菜'是主因而低估柑橘汁，其死后海军一度回摆；1780年代布兰推动全面柠檬汁配给才真正制度化。教训：'有效组合'若不持续做组分归因，认证结论会随权威去世而漂移。
反面警示：库克强制卫生措施极端严苛（强制淋浴、换洗、熏舱），在成果光环下无人质疑；纪律强制若无解释配套，团队成员长期处于服从而非认同状态，创造力岗位流失率上升。
反面警示：欧洲舰队普遍把坏血病归因于'血浊''忧郁'等错误理论，放血疗法反而加速死亡——错误机制下坚持执行，比不执行更致命。教训：执行纪律的前提是至少有一组结果数据支持，纯理论驱动的强制是灾难。
representative_cases_en: First voyage (1768-71): not a single death from scurvy — a record in maritime history — certified by Pringle's Copley Medal address
The sauerkraut gambit: sailors refused it; Cook served officers only, and within a week sailors demanded rations
Second voyage (1772-75): three years at sea with one death (not scurvy), with cleanliness and ventilation rules reinforced

Cautionary: Cook himself over-credited cleanliness and sauerkraut and under-credited citrus; after his death the Navy partially relapsed, and only Blane's push for full lemon-juice rations in the 1780s made it stick. Lesson: an 'effective combination' without ongoing component attribution drifts once its champion dies.

Cautionary: Cook's hygiene regime was extreme (enforced bathing, clothing changes, fumigation); under the halo of results no one questioned it. Discipline without explanation keeps people in compliance rather than commitment — attrition rises in creative roles.

Cautionary: European fleets widely attributed scurvy to 'bad blood' or 'melancholy' and bled patients — accelerating death. Persisting in enforcement under a wrong mechanism is deadlier than not enforcing. Lesson: enforcement discipline requires at least one stream of outcome data; purely theory-driven compulsion is catastrophe.
modern_applications_zh: 新规程推广遇阻时，先让组织内高地位人群可见地使用，利用地位信号带动采纳
病因不明的顽固问题（如慢性疲劳、Burnout）：并行部署多个低成本干预，用结果数据筛选，不等待完整机理
把个人有效经验成文为组织条令，配强制检查点，防止'教训被遗忘'
modern_applications_en: When a new protocol stalls, let high-status members use it visibly — status signals drive adoption
For stubborn problems with unknown causes (chronic fatigue, burnout): deploy several cheap interventions in parallel and let outcome data filter, without waiting for full mechanism
Codify individual wins into written doctrine with enforced checkpoints, so lessons are not forgotten
modes.key_quote_zh: '做对的事，比把事情做对更重要——哪怕你还不知道为什么它是对的。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'Doing the right thing matters more than doing things right — even when you do not yet know why it is right.'

modes.name_en: The Chart-to-Zero Method: Closing the Map by Sailing the Blank
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：地图上的空白不是恐惧的对象而是工作队列——把'未知'变成一条可逐段关闭的测绘清单，每一段航程的产出不是故事而是坐标、水深与岸线。方法论签名有四：其一，双手测绘——库克亲自担任水文测量员，圣罗伦斯河与纽芬兰海图在战后仍被导航使用多年，'船长的第一技能是绘图'；其二，闭环判据——新西兰南北两岛环航一圈即证明其非南方大陆，东部澳大利亚海岸逐段测完即闭合一段空白，'闭合'是可核验的几何事实而非叙述；其三，误差公开——海图上标注未测区段与疑点，后继者按图索骥；其四，命名权与文档绑定——Botany Bay、Society Islands 等命名随海图与日志同步发布，知识产出即时可引用。这一模式把探索从'英雄叙事'改造为'工程进度管理'：空白地图是一张燃尽图，每次航程是一次迭代。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: a blank on the map is not an object of dread but a work queue — turning 'the unknown' into a survey checklist closed segment by segment, where each voyage's output is not a story but coordinates, soundings, and coastlines. Four signatures define the mode. First, the surveyor's hands: Cook served as his own hydrographer; his St. Lawrence and Newfoundland charts guided navigation for years after — the captain's first skill is charting. Second, closure as the criterion: one full circuit of New Zealand proved it no part of any southern continent; the eastern Australian coast, surveyed stretch by stretch, closed a blank segment — 'closure' is a verifiable geometric fact, not a narrative. Third, published uncertainty: unmeasured stretches and dubious points are marked on the chart for successors to pursue. Fourth, naming bound to documentation: Botany Bay, the Society Islands — names released with chart and journal together, knowledge products instantly citable. The mode converts exploration from heroic narrative into engineering progress management: the blank map is a burn-down chart, each voyage an iteration.
modes.source_chapter: 《远征日志》与纽芬兰/圣罗伦斯河海图 (Cook's Journal and Newfoundland charts) / 库克给海军部的报告格式即方法：'本段海岸已测至此，以下为疑点与未测段清单。'
process_zh: 把未知区域编目为待测绘清单，按价值与风险排序航段
亲自掌握测绘技术，指挥链内形成'船长即首席测量员'的标准
以'是否闭合'作为阶段性验收：环航一圈、逐段测完，几何事实宣告完成
海图与日志同步发布，命名、坐标、疑点一并归档供后继者引用
process_en: Catalogue the unknown into a survey queue, sequencing legs by value and risk
Master the surveying craft personally, making 'captain as chief surveyor' a chain-of-command standard
Accept 'closure' as stage acceptance: one full circuit, one fully surveyed coast — geometric facts declare completion
Publish chart and journal together, archiving names, coordinates, and open questions for successors
representative_cases_zh: 纽芬兰测量（1763-1767）：战后海岸测量精确到多年后仍是导航标准，奠定库克的职业声望
新西兰环航（1769-1770）：六个月闭环两岛海岸线，以几何事实终结'新西兰是大陆一角'假说
澳大利亚东海岸（1770）：2000英里海岸逐段测绘，穿越大堡礁后经托雷斯海峡归航，空白段全部闭合
反面警示：1770年6月努力号在大堡礁触礁——测绘再严谨，珊瑚礁的瞬息水文仍超出当时船载测深能力；靠涨潮与人工抛荷才脱险。教训：闭合判据必须包含安全余量与撤退预案，'测完'不等于'测准每一寸'。
反面警示：库克对澳大利亚宣布 terra nullius（无主地）——测绘意义上的'空白'被错误翻译为法律意义上的'无主'，原住民数万年居住被抹除，其恶果延续至今。教训：地图的闭合是物理事实，不能外推为政治与法律结论。
反面警示：黑滴效应使金星凌日观测精度不足，全球数据难以归算日地距离——库克式严谨也救不了测量原理本身的缺陷。教训：验收'闭合'前先审查测量原理的分辨率上限。
representative_cases_en: Newfoundland survey (1763-67): postwar coastal charts remained the navigation standard for years, founding Cook's professional reputation
Circumnavigating New Zealand (1769-70): six months closing both islands' coastlines, killing the 'continental peninsula' hypothesis by geometry
East Australian coast (1770): 2,000 miles surveyed stretch by stretch, threading the Great Barrier Reef and exiting via Torres Strait — every blank closed

Cautionary: in June 1770 the Endeavour struck the Great Barrier Reef — however rigorous the survey, the reef's shifting hydrography exceeded shipboard sounding capability; escape came by tides and lightened ship. Lesson: closure criteria must carry safety margins and retreat plans; 'surveyed' is not 'surveyed to the inch'.

Cautionary: Cook's voyage underwrote terra nullius in Australia — cartographic 'blank' mistranslated into legal 'ownerless', erasing tens of millennia of Aboriginal habitation, with consequences to this day. Lesson: a map's closure is a physical fact and must not be extrapolated into political or legal conclusions.

Cautionary: the black-drop effect degraded the transit observations; worldwide data could not resolve the solar parallax. Lesson: before accepting 'closure', audit the resolution ceiling of the measurement principle itself.
modern_applications_zh: 大型调研/尽调项目采用'空白清单+闭合判据'：交付物是几何式可核验的覆盖，而非叙事性报告
信息地图化：把组织知识盲区编目为测绘队列，每人负责一段，疑点显式标注而非掩盖
成果与文档同步绑定：命名、结论发布时附完整数据源，即时可引用
modern_applications_en: Run large research or due-diligence projects as 'blank checklist + closure criteria': the deliverable is verifiable geometric coverage, not a narrative report
Map knowledge: catalogue organizational blind spots as a survey queue with named owners, open questions marked rather than hidden
Bind findings to documentation at release: names and conclusions ship with full data sources, instantly citable
modes.key_quote_zh: '我不止要比前人走得更远，而是要尽人所能走到最远；但走到的每一处，都必须落在纸上。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'I not only went farther than any man before me, but as far as I think it possible for man to go — and every place reached fell onto paper.'

modes.name_en: The Negative-Proof Expedition: Killing a Legend by Sailing Its predicted Locations
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：对'南大陆'这类流行假说，最有力的处理不是找证据支持它，而是系统地驶过它预言的所有位置——用一次昂贵的航行完成一次决定性的否证。方法论签名有四：其一，把假说改写为可检验预言——'若南大陆存在，则在南纬某带应有陆地'，库克按纬度带做巨型之字形扫掠；其二，负结果同样归档——三次穿越南极圈、1774年抵达南纬71°10′，'无陆地'本身成为重大地理结论；其三，由此及彼的剩余推断——否证'旧南大陆'同时预言'南极冰障之后有陆地'，负证明产出新假设而非空无；其四，理论幻觉的公共清算——达林普等皇家学会权威的信念被一次行动裁决，'相信比怀疑容易'的惯性被打破。这一模式与麦哲伦'地理实存证明'互补：麦哲伦以'至'证有，库克以'遍历'证无——正证与负证是同一工程学的两半。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: for a fashionable hypothesis like the southern continent, the strongest move is not to gather supporting evidence but to sail systematically across every location it predicts — spending one expensive voyage to buy one decisive falsification. Four signatures define the mode. First, rewrite the hypothesis as a testable prediction: 'if Terra Australis exists, land should lie along such latitudes' — and sweep those latitudes in vast zigzags. Second, negative results archived as findings: three crossings of the Antarctic Circle and a record 71°10′ S in 1774 made 'no land' itself a major geographical conclusion. Third, the onward inference: falsifying the old continent simultaneously predicted land beyond the ice barrier — negative proof outputs a new hypothesis, not an empty set. Fourth, public settlement of a theoretical mirage: the convictions of Royal Society authorities like Dalrymple were adjudicated by a single act of sailing, breaking the inertia that believing is easier than doubting. The mode complements Magellan's proof-by-arrival: Magellan proves existence by reaching, Cook proves absence by traversing — positive and negative proof are two halves of the same engineering.
modes.source_chapter: 《朝着南极并环绕世界航行》(1777)；亚历山大·达林普《南太平洋航程史汇》(1770-1771) / 福斯特在航程记录中写道：'库克船长完成了对南大陆幻觉的公共葬礼。'
process_zh: 把流行假说翻译为一条可检验的空间预言（在哪、应有何物）
设计遍历式扫掠航线，让'不存在'成为采样充分的结论而非疏漏
把负结果作为正式发现归档发表，并从中提炼剩余推断
以行动裁决学术权威的悬置争论，终结资源在幻觉方向上的持续消耗
process_en: Translate the popular hypothesis into one testable spatial prediction (where, and what should be there)
Design an exhaustive sweep so 'absence' becomes a well-sampled conclusion, not an oversight
Archive and publish the negative result as a formal finding, distilling its onward inference
Settle suspended academic disputes by action, ending continued resource drain toward a mirage
representative_cases_zh: 第二次航行（1772-1775）：巨型之字形扫掠南太平洋，三次穿越南极圈，证明旧南大陆为神话
南纬71°10′（1774年2月）：18世纪航海家的极南纪录，冰障之外'或有陆地'的预言日后由别林斯高晋实现
新西兰环航（1769-1770）：以环绕一圈证明其非任何大陆之一部，同一方法的先导演练
反面警示：第三次航行寻找西北航道以失败告终——北美大陆北缘不存在可航通道本身是正确的负证明，但库克为此支付的代价包括自己的生命；负证明的成本上限必须预先设定。
反面警示：'无陆地'结论依赖当时船只的冰海生存能力；若在更南的纬度船舶失事，负证明会被误读为'证据不足'而非'假设为假'——负证明的说服力受限于遍历的物理可达域。
反面警示：库克对'南方大陆'的否证常被叙述为个人天才的胜利，掩盖了达林普等人的数据整理工作——负证明的功劳结构容易遮蔽假说提出者与反例收集者的贡献。
representative_cases_en: Second voyage (1772-75): vast zigzag sweeps of the South Pacific, three Antarctic Circle crossings — the old Terra Australis proved myth
71°10′ S (February 1774): the eighteenth century's southern record, with the 'land beyond the ice' prediction later fulfilled by Bellingshausen
New Zealand circuit (1769-70): one enclosing loop proved it no part of any continent — a rehearsal of the same method

Cautionary: the third voyage's Northwest Passage search failed — 'no navigable passage' was the correct negative proof, but the price included Cook's own life; the cost ceiling of falsification must be set in advance.

Cautionary: the 'no land' conclusion depended on contemporary ice-sea survivability; a shipwreck further south would have been misread as 'insufficient evidence' rather than 'hypothesis false' — negative proof's persuasiveness is bounded by the physically reachable domain.

Cautionary: Cook's falsification of Terra Australis is often narrated as a lone-genius victory, obscuring Dalrymple's data compilation — negative-proof credit structures tend to erase the hypothesis-makers and counterexample collectors.
modern_applications_zh: 技术选型中对流行方案做'负证明'：系统测试其预言的全部适用场景，负结果同样写入决策档案
战略规划中把行业迷思（'市场必然存在'）改写为可遍历的检验清单，用一次尽调终结争论
否证之后必须产出剩余推断：旧假设死了，新假设是什么，写进下一轮计划
modern_applications_en: For fashionable solutions, run a negative proof: test every scenario they predict and archive negative results in the decision record
In strategy, rewrite industry myths ('the market must exist') into traversable checklists, settling debate with one due-diligence pass
Every falsification must output its onward inference: the old hypothesis dies — what is the new one? Write it into the next plan
representative_figures: 约翰·雷因霍尔德·福斯特 (J. R. Forster)
modes.key_quote_zh: '我驶过了它预言的每一个位置——南大陆不在那里，这就是发现。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'I sailed over every place it predicted — the southern continent is not there, and that is the discovery.'

modes.name_en: The Science-Party Doctrine: Making Research a Standing Branch of Operations
modes.domain_zh: 科学组织/跨界团队设计
modes.domain_en: Organization of Science / Cross-Disciplinary Team Design
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：把科学家变成行动的常设编制而非临时访客——探索船的甲板上同时运行海军纪律与学术议程，两条线共享同一次航行的成本。方法论签名有四：其一，身份并置——班克斯（自费）、索兰德、帕金森、福斯特父子、天文专员威尔士与舰上军官同吃同住同险，产出从动植物标本到人种志记录；其二，双任务书——皇家学会的观测任务与海军部的探索任务写在同一份命令里，金星凌日与南方大陆互为掩护与借口；其三，成果结构化——首次航行带回约100个新植物科、1000个新种与巨量博物学藏品，'船上建实验室'成为可复制范式（此后小猎犬号沿袭）；其四，预算分摊——科学载荷由学会或富人自费，海军出船出人，风险与成果的合约结构清晰。这一模式把麦哲伦的'亲历笔录'（单人随行记录者）升级为整个科学建制随行——记录者从一个人变成一个学科。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: make scientists a standing branch of operations, not temporary visitors — running naval discipline and an academic agenda on the same deck, both lines sharing one voyage's costs. Four signatures define the mode. First, identity juxtaposition: Banks (self-funded), Solander, Parkinson, the Forsters, and astronomer Wales shared mess, risk, and quarterdeck with naval officers, producing everything from botanical specimens to ethnographic records. Second, the dual charter: the Royal Society's observation task and the Admiralty's exploration task written into one set of orders — the Venus transit and the southern continent as mutual cover and excuse. Third, structured output: the first voyage returned some 100 new plant families, 1,000 new species, and vast natural-history collections — 'a laboratory aboard' became a replicable template (later inherited by the Beagle). Fourth, shared budget: science payloads funded by the Society or private wealth, ships and men by the Navy — a clean contract structure of risk and output. The mode upgrades Magellan's lone eyewitness-scribe into an entire scientific establishment under sail: the recorder grows from one man into a discipline.
modes.source_chapter: 《努力号日志》；班克斯《塔希提日志》；皇家学会1768年委托文件 / 库克在日志中记班克斯团队：'他们收集标本的狂热，与水手收帆的技艺，是同一条船上并行的两种纪律。'
process_zh: 把学术任务写进行动命令：与军事/商业目标并列、互为掩护与正当性来源
科学家与行动者同建制同风险：同吃住、同航程、不设特权仓
成果结构化回收：标本、图表、日志、绘画分类归档，随航程节点逐批整理
预算分摊结构显性化：谁出钱、谁出船、成果归谁，启航前落纸
process_en: Write the academic task into the operational orders: parallel to military or commercial goals, mutual cover and legitimacy
Put scientists on the same footing as operators: shared mess, shared voyage, no privileged cabin
Structure the output recovery: specimens, charts, journals, and drawings archived in classes, batch-processed at voyage milestones
Make the funding split explicit: who pays money, who pays ships, who owns outputs — on paper before departure
representative_cases_zh: 第一次航行（1768-1771）：班克斯自费带七人科学团，带回约100新科/1000新种标本，博塔尼湾因采集规模命名
金星凌日任务与南大陆探索写在同一命令中：科学观测为海军行动提供了公开的正当性叙事
第二航行福斯特父子随行：标本+人种志+艺术（霍奇斯绘画）多轨产出，奠定太平洋民族志基础
反面警示：班克斯与福斯特都曾与舰上军官发生地位冲突（班克斯要求超规格舱位被拒后退出第二航行；福斯特父子与军官长期不和）——科学建制随行的最大内耗是身份与话语权之争。教训：双编制必须预先谈判礼仪与决策权边界。
反面警示：随行艺术家帕金森死于巴达维亚，其植物画作未署名出版引发长期版权争议——成果归属未在启航前落纸，贡献者权益随死亡蒸发。教训：成果合约必须覆盖'成员死亡'情形。
反面警示：第一次航行结束后班克斯名声盖过库克，学界一度只记得'班克斯的航行'——科学光环可能吞没行动指挥者的贡献。教训：双任务书需要配套的贡献署名结构。
representative_cases_en: First voyage (1768-71): Banks self-funded a seven-man science party returning ~100 new families and 1,000 new species; Botany Bay named for the haul
Transit observation and southern-continent search in one set of orders: the scientific observation gave the naval operation its public legitimacy narrative
Second voyage with the Forsters: specimens, ethnography, and Hodges' art on multiple tracks, laying Pacific ethnography's foundations

Cautionary: both Banks and the Forsters clashed with naval officers over status (Banks demanded quarters beyond the ship's capacity and quit the second voyage; the Forsters feuded with officers throughout) — the greatest internal friction of a science-party is the battle over identity and voice. Lesson: negotiate etiquette and decision boundaries between the two branches before embarkation.

Cautionary: the artist Sydney Parkinson died in Batavia and his unpublished botanical drawings sparked long copyright disputes — output ownership never put on paper before departure evaporates with the contributor. Lesson: output contracts must cover member death.

Cautionary: after the first voyage Banks's fame eclipsed Cook's; learned society talk ran to 'Banks's voyage' — the scientific halo can swallow the operator's contribution. Lesson: a dual charter needs a matching attribution structure.
modern_applications_zh: 企业出海/极地科考/深海项目采用'双任务书'：商业目标与科研目标并列，成本共担成果分账
把领域专家编入行动团队编制而非外部顾问：同风险同节奏，产出结构化归档
大型工程（航天、基建）搭载科学载荷：主任务与副任务互为掩护，副产品价值经常超过主任务
modern_applications_en: Adopt a 'dual charter' for overseas ventures, polar or deep-sea programs: commercial and scientific goals in parallel, costs shared, outputs split
Embed domain experts into the operating team rather than as external consultants: shared risk, shared cadence, structured archival output
Carry science payloads on major engineering (space, infrastructure): primary and secondary tasks as mutual cover — byproducts often outvalue the mission
representative_figures: 约翰·雷因霍尔德·福斯特 (J. R. Forster)
modes.key_quote_zh: '一次航行的成本，买回两门学问的进度。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'The cost of one voyage buys the progress of two disciplines.'

modes.name_en: The Tupaia Interface: Borrowing the Local Epistemics to Navigate the Local
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：进入陌生海域，第一件装备不是新海图而是一个本地知识接口——把波利尼西亚领航员图帕亚请上船，让'不知道路'变成'知道谁知道路'。方法论签名有四：其一，接口即网络——图帕亚通晓社 会群岛数百个岛屿的名称、方位与季风航法，他的记忆就是一张活海图，且能以波利尼西亚通用语与沿途各岛对话；其二，双向翻译——图帕亚既替库克导航，也向毛利人解释英国人的来意，两次充当跨文明谈判的缓冲层；其三，知识对等记录——图帕亚绘制的岛屿方位图与库克的测绘图同档保存，班克斯详细记录其口述，本地知识与欧洲知识以同等地位入档；其四，接口失效的边界——图帕亚于1770年死于巴达维亚，且其知识无法覆盖新西兰以南，库克随即退回纯仪器导航——接口是增强而非替代。这一模式与麦哲伦'经验混编'同源，但更进一步：不只混编船员技能，而是把本地知识体系本身作为航行资产收编。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: entering strange waters, the first piece of equipment is not a new chart but a local knowledge interface — bringing the Polynesian navigator Tupaia aboard, converting 'we don't know the way' into 'we know who knows the way.' Four signatures define the mode. First, the interface is a network: Tupaia knew the names, bearings, and monsoon sailing directions of hundreds of Society Islands — his memory was a living chart, and he could speak the pan-Polynesian lingua franca at every landfall. Second, two-way translation: Tupaia navigated for Cook and explained the British to the Maori, twice serving as the buffer layer of cross-civilizational negotiation. Third, knowledge recorded as equal: Tupaia's island-bearing chart and Cook's survey charts were archived together, Banks transcribing his dictation — local and European knowledge entering the record on equal footing. Fourth, the interface's failure boundary: Tupaia died in Batavia in 1770, and his knowledge did not extend south of New Zealand; Cook fell back on pure instrument navigation — the interface augments, never replaces. The mode shares roots with Magellan's mixed crew but goes further: not merely mixing crew skills but enlisting a local knowledge system itself as a sailing asset.
modes.source_chapter: 《努力号日志》；班克斯日志中图帕亚口述记录；图帕亚岛屿方位图（大英图书馆藏） / 班克斯记录图帕亚自述：'我知道的岛屿，比你们所有海图加起来还多。'
process_zh: 登船前先盘点'谁知道路'：识别可收编的本地知识体系及其覆盖半径
给接口配置双向职能：既导出本地知识，也向本地解释外来者意图
以同等地位归档本地知识与外部知识，口述与测绘同档互证
明确接口的能力边界，失效时自动降级到仪器与方法冗余
process_en: Before boarding, inventory 'who knows the way': identify local knowledge systems and their coverage radius
Give the interface two-way duties: export local knowledge, and explain the visitors to the locals
Archive local and external knowledge as equals: oral charts and survey charts co-verified
Mark the interface's competence boundary; on failure degrade automatically to instruments and method redundancy
representative_cases_zh: 图帕亚随航（1769-1770）：从赖阿特阿亚到新西兰，为努力号提供社 会群岛间航法，并向毛利人传译，或解了多次登陆危机
图帕亚方位图：口述岛屿方位与距离给欧洲人记录，成为波利尼西亚航海知识的珍贵档案
图帕亚死后（1770）：库克转回纯仪器导航完成东澳测绘——接口损失未导致任务失败
反面警示：图帕亚于1770年12月死于巴达维亚疫病，其大部分知识未及系统整理即失传——接口的全部价值系于一人性命，无备份即无资产。教训：关键知识接口必须并行文档化，不能只活在'活海图'身上。
反面警示：图帕亚在澳大利亚向会话完全不通的原住民传译失败，库克与原住民关系始终紧张——接口的语言覆盖范围不等于文明互解能力。教训：接口能力有地理与文化边界，不可外推。
反面警示：欧洲史料中图帕亚长期被记为'班克斯的仆人'，其领航贡献两个世纪后才被重估——知识接口的署名与地位若不显式保障，贡献会被接收方叙事吞没。
representative_cases_en: Tupaia aboard (1769-70): from Raiatea to New Zealand, sailing directions across the Society Islands and interpretation with the Maori defused landing crises
Tupaia's chart: island bearings dictated to European recorders — a precious archive of Polynesian navigational knowledge
After Tupaia's death (1770): Cook reverted to pure instrument navigation to finish the east-Australian survey — the loss of the interface failed no mission

Cautionary: Tupaia died of the Batavia epidemics in December 1770, most of his knowledge lost before systematic transcription — an interface's whole value hung on one life, and without backup there is no asset. Lesson: key knowledge interfaces must be documented in parallel, never left living only in a 'living chart'.

Cautionary: in Australia Tupaia's interpretation failed against mutually unintelligible languages, and Cook's relations with Aboriginal people stayed tense — an interface's language coverage is not civilizational comprehension. Lesson: interface competence has geographic and cultural bounds; do not extrapolate.

Cautionary: European records long filed Tupaia as 'Banks's servant'; his navigational contribution was revalued only two centuries later — without explicit status guarantees, the interface's credit is swallowed by the receiver's narrative.
modern_applications_zh: 进入新市场/新领域先配置'图帕亚接口'：本地顾问的覆盖半径、翻译职能与失效预案写入合作条款
跨文化项目设双向翻译岗：既向内解释本地规则，也向本地解释组织意图，缓冲层不可省略
本地知识与外部方法论对等入档，口述经验正式归档为组织资产
modern_applications_en: Entering a new market or domain, first hire a 'Tupaia interface': local advisor's coverage radius, translation duties, and failure plan written into the terms
Staff a two-way translation role in cross-cultural projects: explaining local rules inward and organizational intent outward — the buffer is not optional
Archive local knowledge as equal to external methodology, formally codifying oral expertise as organizational assets
modes.key_quote_zh: '最好的海图，有时是一位活人的记忆。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'The best chart is sometimes the memory of a living man.'

modes.name_en: The Landfall-Rhythm Method: Breaking a Long Siege into Recoverable Segments
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：长程行动的耐力不来自意志而来自节律——把漫长的海上消耗切成一个个'上岸窗口'，每窗口强制完成物资、健康与士气的三重恢复。方法论签名有四：其一，窗口即检查点——每到一地即执行固定清单：淡水、鲜蔬、木柴、修船、天象观测，节律化到接近仪式；其二，健康是节律函数——'抓住每个靠岸机会获取新鲜食物'与船上持续执行的酸菜麦芽汁并行，靠岸节律成为防病体系的一半；其三，观测机会最大化——塔希提设天文台、新西兰逐岛测绘，每个窗口同时服务于科学任务；其四，窗口亦有风险——巴达维亚窗口带来疫病，30余人死于登岸后的'恢复'，窗口选择本身是风险管理。这一模式与郑和'节律窗口'同构而更微操作化：郑和以季风定节律，库克以恢复需求定节律——前者宏观排程，后者微观补给。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: endurance in a long operation comes not from willpower but from rhythm — slicing prolonged attrition into 'landfall windows', each one compelled to deliver triple recovery of provisions, health, and morale. Four signatures define the mode. First, the window as checkpoint: at every landfall a fixed checklist ran — water, fresh greens, firewood, ship repair, sky observation — rhythmic almost to ritual. Second, health as a function of rhythm: seizing every landfall for fresh food ran parallel to the shipboard sauerkraut-and-wort regime; the rhythm of landfalls was half the anti-scorbutic system. Third, maximizing observation: the Tahiti observatory and island-by-island New Zealand survey meant every window also served the scientific task. Fourth, windows carry risk too: the Batavia window brought epidemic, over thirty dying from the 'recovery' itself — window selection is risk management. The mode is isomorphic with Zheng He's rhythm window but micro-operational: Zheng He set rhythm by monsoon, Cook by recovery need — the former macro-scheduling, the latter micro-provisioning.
modes.source_chapter: 《努力号日志》各靠岸港记录；《朝着南极并环绕世界航行》健康章 / 库克的靠岸清单几乎是仪式性的：'到岸第一日：水、蔬、柴；第二日：观测；第三日：修船。'
process_zh: 把长程任务切分为固定节律的恢复窗口，每窗口绑定强制清单
健康与士气指标纳入窗口验收：物资、病员、心理三项逐项核销
窗口同时排入任务产出：观测、测绘、标本采集与补给并行
对窗口本身做风险评估：恢复地的疫病、政治、补给可靠性逐项打分
process_en: Slice long operations into rhythmically fixed recovery windows, each bound to a mandatory checklist
Fold health and morale into window acceptance: provisions, sick list, and psychology checked off one by one
Queue task outputs into every window: observation, survey, specimen work run parallel with provisioning
Risk-score the windows themselves: disease, politics, and supply reliability of each recovery port
representative_cases_zh: 塔希提窗口（1769）：设维纳斯堡天文台完成金星凌日观测，同时补给与休整，一窗口三产出
各岛逐站补给（1769-1770）：新西兰海岸测绘与鲜蔬淡水补给逐段交替，船员健康贯穿全程
巴达维亚窗口（1770）：致命反例——疫病击垮船队，30余人死于'恢复地'，库克此后高度警惕恢复地卫生
反面警示：巴达维亚（1770）——为修船进入疫病港口，超过30人死于痢疾与伤寒，包括天文学家格林、艺术家帕金森等科学团核心。教训：恢复窗口的选择错误可以吞掉整个行动的人才投资。
反面警示：库克在部分岛屿因补给需求过急而采取得罪当地人的行动（如新西兰毛利人冲突中的武力使用）——窗口压力可能诱发短视行为，损害长期关系资产。教训：窗口清单需包含'关系维护'项。
反面警示：第三次航行白令海峡受阻后折返夏威夷过冬，恰逢节律之外的非计划窗口，补给紧张与关系恶化叠加导致库克之死。教训：节律外的被迫窗口风险最高，须预留缓冲资源。
representative_cases_en: The Tahiti window (1769): Fort Venus observatory completed the transit while the ship provisioned and rested — one window, three outputs
Island-by-island provisioning (1769-70): New Zealand survey and fresh-food resupply alternated segment by segment, crew health held throughout
The Batavia window (1770): the fatal counterexample — epidemic felled the fleet, thirty-plus dead in the 'recovery port'; Cook henceforth wary of port hygiene

Cautionary: Batavia (1770) — entering a disease port for ship repair, thirty-plus died of dysentery and typhus, including astronomer Green and artist Parkinson, the science party's core. Lesson: a wrongly chosen recovery window can swallow the operation's whole talent investment.

Cautionary: at some islands Cook's urgency for provisions bred offenses against locals (armed clashes with Maori among them) — window pressure can trigger short-sighted acts that damage long-term relationship assets. Lesson: the window checklist must include a 'relationship maintenance' item.

Cautionary: blocked at Bering Strait on the third voyage, Cook wintered in Hawaii — an off-rhythm, unplanned window where tight provisioning and souring relations compounded into his death. Lesson: forced off-rhythm windows are the riskiest; buffer resources must be reserved.
modern_applications_zh: 长期项目设置强制恢复节律：每N周一个检查点，物资、健康、士气三项清单核销，不因进度压力跳过
出差/外派人员按'上岸窗口'管理：恢复节点与任务节点合排，防止慢性消耗
恢复节点本身要做风险评估： Choosing the wrong 'safe harbor' can be deadlier than the open sea
modern_applications_en: Impose mandatory recovery rhythm on long projects: a checkpoint every N weeks with provisions-health-morale checklists, never skipped under schedule pressure
Manage expatriates by landfall windows: recovery nodes co-scheduled with task nodes to prevent chronic attrition
Risk-assess the recovery nodes themselves: the wrong 'safe harbor' can be deadlier than open sea
modes.key_quote_zh: '海上的每一天都在消耗，岸上的每一天都必须偿还。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'Every day at sea spends; every day ashore must repay.'

modes.name_en: The Status-Symbol Method: Managing the Symbolic Weight of the Visitor
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：外来者的身份不由自己宣告而由对方的符号系统解读——管理好自己被解读成的那个符号，比管理自己的真实意图更决定生死。方法论签名有四：其一，符号入乡随俗——库克在夏威夷受隆诺祭司引导入希基亚乌神庙、被欢呼为'隆诺'，他接受了祭司系统赋予的仪式地位；其二，符号有季节——马卡希基节（和平丰产）期间他是'隆诺'，战神库的季节回归后符号已过期，他却带着破损的主桅回到同一海湾；其三，符号透支——祭司的礼遇与平民的 metals 需求错位，铁器贸易的通胀侵蚀特权，偷窃与鞭刑循环升级；其四，误判的代价——1779年2月14日库克试图绑架卡拉尼奥普乌为人质，把一个神圣首领当作可以武力扣押的'当地人'处理，符号误读直接致命。这一模式与郑和'仪式秩序替代'互为镜像：郑和主动经营符号，库克被动接受符号——接受而不经营者，终被符号反噬。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: the visitor's identity is not declared by himself but read through the other side's symbol system — managing the symbol you are read as matters more to survival than managing your true intent. Four signatures define the mode. First, symbolic custom: led by Lono priests into the Hikiau temple and hailed as 'Lono', Cook accepted the ritual status the priestly system conferred. Second, symbols have seasons: during Makahiki (peace and plenty) he was Lono; after the war-god Ku's season returned the symbol had expired — yet he re-entered the same bay with a broken mainmast. Third, symbolic overdraft: the priests' honors sat ill with commoners' metal hunger; iron-trade inflation eroded privilege, theft and flogging escalating in cycles. Fourth, the price of misreading: on 14 February 1779 Cook tried to seize Kalani'opu'u as hostage, treating a sacred paramount chief as a detainer 'native' — the symbolic misreading killed him outright. The mode mirrors Zheng He's ritual-order substitution: Zheng He curated symbols actively; Cook received them passively — and the unmanaged symbol ends by devouring its bearer.
modes.source_chapter: 《第三次航行记录》(Cook and King, 1784)；萨林斯-奥贝赛克拉之争 (Sahlins-Obeyesekere debate, 1985-1995) / 克利克牧师日记记录：'祭司在库克前面开道，宣告奥罗诺（隆诺）已登陆，命众人伏地。'
process_zh: 入场时识别对方符号系统给自己的位置，并决定接受/修正/回避
标记符号的有效期：节令、政治周期、资源行情都会让符号过期
监测符号的通货膨胀：礼遇被滥用、物质需求攀升时提前止损
永远不为'过期符号'加注：识别误判苗头时立即降级自己的行为模式
process_en: On entry, identify where the other's symbol system places you, and decide to accept, correct, or decline the slot
Tag the symbol's expiry: seasons, political cycles, and market moods all age symbols
Monitor symbolic inflation: when honors are abused and material demands climb, cut losses early
Never double down on an expired symbol: at the first sign of misreading, downgrade your own behavior mode
representative_cases_zh: 马卡希基季节（1779年1月）：库克被祭司引为'隆诺'受万人俯拜，物资补给畅通无阻
符号季节更替（2月初）：战神库季节开始，氛围转变，偷窃与摩擦上升，库克未显著调整行为
2月14日事件：绑架人质策略触发致命冲突，库克与4名陆战队员、17名夏威夷人死亡——符号误判的终局
反面警示：'库克被奉为神'的叙事本身可能是欧洲中心神话——奥贝赛克拉指出夏威夷人未必视其为神，或只是视作名为隆诺的首领；胜利者档案中的符号解读需做殖民偏差校正。教训：符号管理研究必须校验记录者立场。
反面警示：库克此前在汤加、塔希提已有绑架首领换赃物的'成功'先例——路径依赖让他在夏威夷重复一个此前险些失控的策略。教训：符号策略的成功案例会掩盖其结构性风险。
反面警示：萨林斯与奥贝赛克拉的学术争论持续十年、几成门户对立——对同一符号事件的解读分歧本身说明符号的不可复原性，档案重建永远低于现场确定性。
representative_cases_en: The Makahiki season (January 1779): priests inducted Cook as 'Lono' before prostrating crowds, provisioning ran unimpeded
Symbolic season change (early February): the season of Ku opened, atmosphere shifted, theft and friction climbed — Cook's behavior did not visibly adjust
14 February: the hostage gambit triggered the lethal clash — Cook, four marines, and seventeen Hawaiians dead, the terminus of symbolic misreading

Cautionary: the 'Cook was worshipped as a god' narrative may itself be a European-centric myth — Obeyesekere argued Hawaiians need not have seen a god, perhaps only a chief named Lono; symbolic readings in the victors' archives demand colonial-bias correction. Lesson: symbol-management research must audit the recorder's standpoint.

Cautionary: Cook had 'successful' precedents of seizing chiefs for stolen goods in Tonga and Tahiti — path dependence made him repeat in Hawaii a strategy that had nearly failed before. Lesson: successful cases of symbolic strategy conceal its structural risk.

Cautionary: the Sahlins-Obeyesekere controversy ran a decade into near-schismatic opposition — that one symbolic event splits scholarly readings proves symbols are irrecoverable; archival reconstruction never reaches field certainty.
modern_applications_zh: 跨国高管空降新市场时管理'被解读成的身份'：当地赋予的仪式地位有节令与政治周期，过期前主动退场或重新定位
品牌出海识别符号通胀：'洋品牌'溢价随本地替代品成熟而衰减，须在衰减前完成价值重锚
谈判者识别对方符号系统中的季节：同一个头衔在预算周期与政治周期中价值完全不同
modern_applications_en: Expatriate executives must manage the identity they are read as: locally conferred ritual status has seasons and political cycles — reposition or exit before expiry
Brand builders should watch symbolic inflation: the 'foreign brand' premium decays as local alternatives mature; re-anchor value before the decay
Negotiators must read the seasons in the other side's symbol system: the same title is worth entirely different things across budget and political cycles
modes.key_quote_zh: '他不是死于武器落后，而是死于符号过期。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'He did not die of inferior weapons; he died of an expired symbol.'

modes.name_en: The Two-Ship Redundancy: Designing Failure Margin into Fleet Structure
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：单船远航的全部风险都押在一根龙骨上——把编队本身做成冗余结构，让'一船失事'降级为'任务受挫'而不是'任务清零'。方法论签名有四：其一，双船结构——第二次航行决心号配冒险号（库克/弗尼厄克斯），第一次大堡礁触礁的直接教训被转写为舰队构型；其二，分进合击——两船可分开扫掠不同海域、失散后互有约定的备用会合点，冗余同时提供覆盖能力；其三，牺牲序位预设——冒险号船员在塔斯曼海域的损失（10人被疑食人）证明分航的风险真实存在，但编队的预期损失结构仍优于单船全损；其四，装备冗余——第二次航行备双重龙骨包铜、双份仪器、四具计时器，关键能力全部双份。这一模式与麦哲伦五船队'分船队协同'对照：麦哲伦以数量换覆盖，库克以双份换保底——覆盖与保底是冗余设计的两个方向。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: a single-ship voyage stakes everything on one keel — make the formation itself a redundant structure, so 'one ship lost' degrades to 'mission set back', never 'mission erased'. Four signatures define the mode. First, two-ship structure: Resolution paired with Adventure (Cook/Furneaux) on the second voyage — the direct lesson of the Great Barrier Reef grounding rewritten into fleet configuration. Second, split-sweep convergence: the ships could sweep different waters apart, with agreed fallback rendezvous if separated — redundancy doubling as coverage. Third,预设 loss order: the Adventure's losses in Tasman waters (ten men suspected killed and eaten) proved the real risk of detached sailing, yet the formation's expected-loss structure still beat single-ship total loss. Fourth, equipment redundancy: on the second voyage a sheathed double-fastened hull, duplicate instruments, and four timekeepers — every critical capability doubled. The mode contrasts with Magellan's five-ship squadron protocol: Magellan traded quantity for coverage, Cook traded duplication for a floor — coverage and floor are the two directions of redundancy design.
modes.source_chapter: 《朝着南极并环绕世界航行》；海军部第二次航行装备清单 / 库克在装备清单上的批注：'宁可在伦敦多花一镑，不在太平洋赌一条命。'
key_concepts: 分进合击与备用会合点
process_zh: 把历史事故教训直接转写为结构设计：上次单点失效，这次上双份
设计分进合击战术：独立扫掠+失散约定会合点，冗余与覆盖兼得
关键能力全部双份：船体、仪器、计时器、医疗物资按双份配置
预算风险结构显性化：接受'编队部分损失'以消除'单船全损'
process_en: Translate past accident lessons directly into structure: last time a single point failed, this time double it
Design split-sweep tactics: independent coverage plus agreed rendezvous, redundancy and coverage both served
Duplicate every critical capability: hull, instruments, timekeepers, and medical stores all in pairs
Make the risk budget explicit: accept partial formation loss to eliminate single-ship total loss
representative_cases_zh: 第二次航行双船配置（1772）：努力号大堡礁触礁的直接产物，决心号+冒险号互为保险
分进合击实践：两船多次分开扫掠南太平洋不同海域，失散后按约定会合点重逢
第一次航行单船记录（1768-1771）：大堡礁触礁几乎全损，正反两次经验构成完整的冗余论证
反面警示：冒险号分航后其船员10人在新西兰被杀（时人怀疑食人）——分进合击的覆盖收益以分航风险为代价，冗余结构内部的每个单元都需要独立的生存能力。教训：冗余单元不能共享同一弱点。
反面警示：第二次航行冒险号中途返英，编队实际单船运行大半程——冗余结构在预算/进度压力下最易被削减，'双份'常在执行中退化为'单份+心理安慰'。教训：冗余决策须绑定不可削减条款。
反面警示：库克死后克利克接任再死于肺结核，戈尔再接任——指挥链冗余起效了，但连续损失说明南极-北极连续远航的人力成本结构被系统性低估。教训：冗余设计覆盖不了慢性消耗型风险。
representative_cases_en: The two-ship configuration (1772): the direct product of the Reef grounding — Resolution and Adventure as mutual insurance
Split-sweep practice: the ships repeatedly detached to sweep different Pacific waters, reuniting at agreed rendezvous
The single-ship record (1768-71): the near-total loss on the Reef, with the two voyages together forming the complete argument for redundancy

Cautionary: after detaching, ten of the Adventure's men were killed in New Zealand (suspected cannibalism at the time) — the coverage gain of split-sweep was paid in detachment risk; every redundant unit needs independent survivability. Lesson: redundant units must not share one weakness.

Cautionary: the Adventure returned to England midway, leaving the formation effectively single-ship for most of the voyage — redundant structures are the first cut under budget and schedule pressure, 'doubled' often degrading to 'single plus comfort'. Lesson: bind redundancy decisions to non-reduction clauses.

Cautionary: after Cook's death Clerke took command and died of tuberculosis, then Gore — the succession chain worked, but the consecutive losses show the human-cost structure of continuous polar voyaging was systematically underestimated. Lesson: redundancy design does not cover chronic-attrition risks.
modern_applications_zh: 关键基础设施设计采用'库克双船'：单点全损场景必须存在结构级备份，而非仅流程级备份
大型项目拆分交付单元并约定会合点：各单元独立推进、失联后按既定节点汇合
重要数据/人员配置双份冗余：备份间隔足够远，确保同一灾害无法同时击中两份
modern_applications_en: Design critical infrastructure on the 'Cook two-ship' principle: single-point total-loss scenarios need structural backup, not merely procedural
Split large projects into delivery units with agreed rendezvous: units advance independently and converge at preset nodes if contact is lost
Duplicate critical data and personnel with sufficient separation so one disaster cannot hit both copies
representative_figures: 托比亚斯·弗尼厄克斯 (Tobias Furneaux)
modes.key_quote_zh: '两艘船的意义不是快一倍，而是必达一次。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'Two ships do not mean twice as fast; they mean arriving at least once.'

modes.name_en: The Journal-Relay Method: Routing the Archive Home Faster Than the Fleet
modes.definition_zh: 库克的元命题：探险的发现价值随消息抵达时间递减——让档案先于船队回家，用接力路由压缩知识旅行的时间。方法论签名有四：其一，多跳路由——库克之死与日志经堪察加军事长官冯·贝姆之手，由陆路穿越西伯利亚送往伦敦，比绕好望角的船队早近一年抵达海军部；其二，档案与载具解耦——日志的传递不依赖生还者，克利克把日志与死亡报告封装移交，信息在指挥者死后继续旅行；其三，内容分版——库克生前日志与官方出版叙事（经约翰·霍克斯沃斯整理）分属两个版本，一手档案与公共叙事并行；其四，传递即占位——消息早到一年，英国的地图修订、政治决策与后续探险提前启动，信息先到者获得议程设置权。这一模式与郑和'档案断代审计'相反：郑和档案因制度停转而散佚，库克档案靠接力路由而永生——档案的命运取决于传递结构而非保存意愿。
modes.definition_en: Cook's master proposition: an expedition's discovery value decays with the arrival time of its news — route the archive home faster than the fleet, compressing knowledge travel by relay. Four signatures define the mode. First, multi-hop routing: Cook's death and journals passed through the Kamchatka military commander Magnus von Behm, travelling overland through Siberia to reach the Admiralty nearly a year before the fleet rounded the Cape. Second, archive decoupled from carrier: the journals' journey did not depend on survivors — Clerke sealed the logs with the death report and handed them on; the information kept travelling after its author died. Third, content versioning: Cook's own journals and the official published narrative (assembled by John Hawkesworth) ran as parallel editions — first-hand archive and public narrative side by side. Fourth, arrival as agenda-setting: a year's head start meant British chart revisions, political decisions, and follow-up expeditions launched earlier — first information sets the agenda. The mode inverts Zheng He's archival audit: Zheng He's records scattered when the institution stopped; Cook's endure by relay routing — an archive's fate depends on transmission structure, not preservation intent.
modes.source_chapter: 克利克致冯·贝姆移交函（1779）；海军部档案；霍克斯沃斯编《南海航行纪》(1773) / 克利克移交函的措辞即方法：'日志与报告完整移交，海路漫长而陆路更短。'
key_concepts: 一手档案与公共叙事分版
process_zh: 识别最短知识路径：消息传递的地理与政治路由逐段规划
把档案封装为可独立移交的单元：附说明信、状态报告，不依赖任何特定人员生还
一手日志与对外出版分版管理，保留原始记录的独立性
评估信息早到的议程价值：优先把档案送抵决策点而非仅送抵保存点
process_en: Map the shortest knowledge route: plan the geographic and political hops of message transmission segment by segment
Package the archive as an independently hand-off-able unit: cover letter and status report attached, dependent on no survivor
Manage first-hand journals and public publications as separate versions, preserving the raw record's independence
Price the agenda value of early arrival: route archives to decision points, not merely to storage points
representative_cases_zh: 西伯利亚陆路接力（1779-1780）：克利克在堪察加把库克日志与死亡报告交冯·贝姆，陆路抵伦敦，早于船队近一年
霍克斯沃斯版本（1773）：官方叙事先于一手日志出版，公众认知由整理者框架塑形——档案分版的经典案例
库克日志的现代整理（贝格尔霍尔版）：一手档案完整存世，成为18世纪太平洋研究的原始基座
反面警示：霍克斯沃斯整理版以戏剧化叙事与编者润色著称，船员普遍不满，库克本人的克制笔触被覆盖——公共叙事版本若不经当事者审校，会反噬一手档案的公信力。教训：分版必须配套'一手优先'的引用规范。
反面警示：库克死后夏威夷段记录完全依赖幸存者转述，库克本人对最后数周的观察永久缺失——档案接力无法传递未及落笔的内容。教训：关键期记录必须实时落笔，不能指望事后接力。
反面警示：消息早到一年同时让领土主张与殖民规划提前启动——信息先到的议程价值是中性的，先到者可以将其用于任何目的。教训：路由结构决定不了信息用途，须配套伦理约束。
representative_cases_en: The Siberian overland relay (1779-80): Clerke handed Cook's journals and the death report to von Behm at Kamchatka; overland it reached London nearly a year before the fleet
The Hawkesworth edition (1773): official narrative published before the first-hand journals, public cognition shaped by the assembler's frame — the classic case of archive versioning
The modern Beaglehole edition of Cook's journals: the first-hand archive survives whole, the raw foundation of Pacific studies

Cautionary: the Hawkesworth edition, famous for dramatic narrative and editorial polish, drew crew discontent; Cook's restrained voice was overwritten — a public version unreviewed by the protagonist can backfire on the first-hand archive's credibility. Lesson: versioning requires a 'first-hand-first' citation rule.

Cautionary: after Cook's death the Hawaiian segment rests entirely on survivors' accounts; his own observations of the final weeks are permanently missing — relay cannot transmit what was never written. Lesson: critical-period records must be written in real time, never deferred to relay.

Cautionary: the year-early arrival also let territorial claims and colonial planning start earlier — the agenda value of first information is neutral; first arrivals can use it for any purpose. Lesson: routing structure does not determine information use; ethical constraints must ride along.
modern_applications_zh: 危机事件的信息发布采用'接力路由'：核心事实包先走最快通道抵达决策层，不必等完整报告
关键知识资产设计'不依赖任何人生还'的移交机制：附状态说明的封装单元、多路由副本
一手记录与对外叙事分版维护：对外发布前保留原始档案独立性，防止叙事漂移污染原始数据
modern_applications_en: Route crisis information by relay: the core fact package takes the fastest channel to decision-makers, not waiting for the full report
Design 'no-survivor-required' handover for key knowledge assets: sealed units with status letters and multi-route copies
Maintain first-hand records and public narratives as separate versions, keeping raw archives independent so narrative drift cannot pollute the data
representative_figures: 马格努斯·冯·贝姆 (Magnus von Behm)
modes.key_quote_zh: '船队还在好望角，地图已经改版。'
modes.key_quote_en: 'The fleet was still at the Cape; the chart was already in its new edition.'
